bio: Tonhaka is the finest brewer in all of Freeport – a dangerous thing to be, since the only people not trying to steal his brew are trying to steal his recipe. Fortunately, Tonhaka is as good a brawler as a brewer, and so far there’s been no army tough enough to pry his secret ingredients out of him.
